questions.explanation: No article before single mountains like Mount Everest.
questions.q: ___ Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

questions.explanation: 'The' before musical instruments: 'the piano'.
'The hospital' as a visitor; no article when you're a patient.
questions.q: He went to ___ hospital to visit his friend.

questions.explanation: 'The' before river names: 'the Nile'.
questions.q: ___ Nile is the longest river in Africa.

questions.explanation: 'A' before a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time.
questions.q: They stayed at ___ small hotel near the station.

questions.explanation: No article before meals: 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner'.
No article before sports: 'tennis', 'football'.
No article when someone is in prison as a prisoner.
'The' + nationality adjective for the whole people: 'the French'.
questions.q: ___ French are famous for their food.

questions.explanation: 'The' before seas and oceans.
'An' before a vowel sound: 'an honest' (silent h).
No article before 'work' as a place/activity.
questions.q: He goes to ___ work by bus.

questions.explanation: 'The' + adjective for groups of people: 'the rich', 'the poor'.
'A' first mention, 'the' second mention.
questions.q: I saw ___ film last night. ___ film was great.

questions.explanation: No article before meals: 'had breakfast', not 'had a breakfast'.
options: She had a breakfast at eight.
We swam in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.explanation: 'The' before plural country names: 'the United States'.
questions.q: ___ United States is a large country.

questions.explanation: 'A' before a consonant sound: 'a university' (pronounced 'yoo').
No article for general plural statements: 'Dogs are...'.
No article before single mountains.
options: The Mount Fuji is in Japan.
A Mount Fuji is in Japan.
An Mount Fuji is in Japan.
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correct?

questions.explanation: Fixed expression: 'in a hurry'.
